description: This Java class 'URLConnector' provides methods to open HTTP/HTTPS URL connections with support for SSL configurations, timeouts, and trust management. It includes internal threading for connection establishment and handles trusted and untrusted certificates.

classes.name: URLConnector
classes.description: A utility class for establishing HTTP/HTTPS URL connections with SSL configuration and timeout handling.

methods.name: openConnection
methods.description: Opens a URLConnection with specified timeout, SSL settings, and optional client certificate.

methods.name: openUntrustedConnection
methods.description: Opens a URLConnection that allows untrusted SSL certificates.
